
cdrom/cd-speedack2
The drive's busy windows after a Pause: a Getstat W cycles after a paused read's INT2.
Cycles at the system clock (1 ms = 33,869) from the Getstat's write to its INT3, its stat beside it. No assertions - compare against your emulator.
